text: Kalkoti is an endangered indigenous language of Pakistan. It belongs to the Indo-European language family. The language is used as a first language by adults only.

text: Kalkoti, also known as Goedijaa, is an endangered Indo-Aryan language of the Shina group, spoken by approximately 6,000 people primarily in the village of Kalkot in the Upper Dir District of Khyber Pa.
